bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null
before="$(stat -c '%i:%s:%Y' "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,stat,shutil
root=Path("/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot")
a=root/"scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
b=root/"scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
backup=root/"scripts/.profile-topic-rollback-20261114"
backup.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
for p in (a,b):
 if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():raise SystemExit("USERBOT_SOURCE_PATH_INVALID")
 if not (backup/p.name).exists(): shutil.copy2(p,backup/p.name)
a_text=a.read_text(); b_text=b.read_text()
if "profile_topics_readback" in a_text or "profile_topics_readback" in b_text:
 raise SystemExit("USERBOT_PATCH_ALREADY_PRESENT")
a_anchor='    if action == "room_private_smoke":'
b_anchor='        if "row_sizes" in result:'
if a_text.count(a_anchor)!=1 or b_text.count(b_anchor)!=1 or a_text.count('ACTIONS = frozenset({')!=1:
 raise SystemExit("USERBOT_SOURCE_ANCHOR_CHANGED")
a_text=a_text.replace('ACTIONS = frozenset({','ACTIONS = frozenset({"profile_topics_readback", ',1)
a_text=a_text.replace(a_anchor,"    if action == \"profile_topics_readback\":\n        # Telegram's USER API returns real forum topic IDs, not t.me/c message\n        # suffixes. Only inspect the three already-approved boards, read-only.\n        from telethon import functions\n        dialogs = await client.get_dialogs(limit=500)\n        targets = (\n            (\"area_bbs\", -1003847210571),\n            (\"video_chat\", -1002373696859),\n            (\"gay_board\", -1003770334893),\n        )\n        results = []\n        for board, chat_id in targets:\n            entity = next((d.entity for d in dialogs if d.id == chat_id), None)\n            if entity is None:\n                raise RuntimeError(\"PROFILE_READ_GROUP_NOT_IN_EXISTING_DIALOGS\")\n            forum = await client(functions.messages.GetForumTopicsRequest(\n                peer=entity, q=\"みんなのプロフ\",\n                offset_date=0, offset_id=0, offset_topic=0, limit=100))\n            matches = [t for t in forum.topics\n                       if \"みんなのプロフ\" in getattr(t, \"title\", \"\")]\n            if len(matches) > 1:\n                raise RuntimeError(\"PROFILE_READ_MULTIPLE_TOPICS\")\n            results.append({\"board\": board, \"chat_id\": chat_id,\n                            \"thread_id\": int(matches[0].id) if matches else None,\n                            \"found\": len(matches) == 1})\n        return {\"request_id\": request_id, \"action\": action, \"status\": \"PASS\",\n                \"topics\": results}\n"+a_anchor,1)
old='"TARGET_NOT_BOT", "PEER_UID_NOT_ALLOWED",'
if a_text.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit("USERBOT_SAFE_CODE_ANCHOR_CHANGED")
a_text=a_text.replace(old,'"PROFILE_READ_GROUP_NOT_IN_EXISTING_DIALOGS", "PROFILE_READ_MULTIPLE_TOPICS",\n                '+old,1)
b_text=b_text.replace(b_anchor,"        if args.action == \"profile_topics_readback\":\n            topics = result.get(\"topics\")\n            if (not isinstance(topics, list) or len(topics) != 3\n                    or any(not isinstance(t, dict) or t.get(\"board\") not in\n                           {\"area_bbs\", \"video_chat\", \"gay_board\"}\n                           or type(t.get(\"found\")) is not bool\n                           or (t[\"found\"] and (type(t.get(\"thread_id\")) is not int\n                                                or t[\"thread_id\"] <= 0))\n                           for t in topics)):\n                raise RuntimeError(\"PROFILE_TOPICS_CONTRACT_INVALID\")\n            print(\"USERBOT_PROFILE_TOPICS=\" + json.dumps(\n                topics, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(\",\", \":\")))\n"+b_anchor,1)
for p,t in ((a,a_text),(b,b_text)):
 compile(t,str(p),"exec")
 mode=stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)
 tmp=p.with_suffix(p.suffix+".topicstage")
 with tmp.open("w") as handle:
  handle.write(t);handle.flush();os.fsync(handle.fileno())
 os.chmod(tmp,mode);os.replace(tmp,p)
print("USERBOT_CODE_ONLY_STAGED=PASS")
PY
rollback(){
 rc=$?
 if test "$rc" -ne 0; then
  cp -p "$r/scripts/.profile-topic-rollback-20261114/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
  cp -p "$r/scripts/.profile-topic-rollback-20261114/userbot_test_client.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
  echo USERBOT_CODE_ONLY_ROLLBACK_REQUESTED
 fi
}
trap rollback EXIT
python3 -m py_compile "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 4
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
test "$(stat -c '%i:%s:%Y' "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = "$before"
python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null
python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" profile_topics_readback
echo RESIDENT_USERBOT_PROFILE_TOPIC_READBACK=PASS
